Twelve mode/grid/branch solves plus one analytic-Jv constant-eta=1e-8 control. GMRES restart24/max96, at most 24 Newton steps and nonlinear tolerance1e-9. Solve both Bratu branches with three Jv choices without assembling the nonlinear Jacobian; retain forcing, actual residuals and evaluation counts.
